notes.title: Post Doujin Market and Future Plans
notes.content:
Hello all! Ivan here.

It has been 2 weeks since our last physical event at Doujin Market! 
We've enjoyed ourselves and I hope those who've dropped by to say hi managed to get something out of this.

Ultimately, as a team, we think that the current demo/prototype is a bit too unpolished/incomplete to be shown to public. Hence, we have decided to take it down again as we prepare for more to come.

We will put out a more detailed roadmap down the road, as well as more consistent updates for those staying tune.

That's all for now.

notes.title: Indie Jam, Doujin Market and Future Plans
notes.content:
Happy Labour Day, for those in the world that celebrates it. (Sorry people in the US)

Pardon the radio silence for the past few months. Oyen Studio as a team are doing this as a passion, and we all have a dayjob on top of that.

To summarize, the previous demo/version of the game that some might have tried would be removed and reworked into something that would be leaning more towards a Visual Novel + Cooking Simulator gameplay. 
We had lukewarm feedback regarding it, and as a team we decided to double down on trying to sell the experience of actually being in another world. From the world building, characters/races, to the cuisine.
You will still see some old screenshots on Steam, but we will work on changing it out as the game develops.

Meanwhile, we have been working up to some in-person events such as Indie Jam in Malaysia, as well as the upcoming Doujin Market. Indie Jam was a success, and many have positive feedback regarding the art style and direction we are moving in. So we are confident to deliver something that we can be proud of, that players can enjoy.

Currently, we have a small snippet of what would potentially be the new direction we are moving in. For those who have tried, thank you. It might bug out, but rest assured that there will be a polished demo by next week.


Tech Lead
Ivan

notes.title: Hello Wanderers on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello, Ivan here. You might have stumbled upon the game as Cooking Fest is going on. If so, welcome!

I am the founder and tech lead of Oyen Studio. We are a small indie studio from Singapore, formed from a group of friends. 

I am going to ramble a bit so feel free to skip till the end.

You might have noticed that the screenshots look really rough right now. 
We are aware that the game is not as stable as it should be, and are working hard to bring it up to date so that you get the best demo experience during Cooking Fest.

[h2]Game Beginnings:[/h2]

We started work in July, and even as we juggled our day jobs and this project, I am proud to see the game develop over the past 4 months. So please pardon any placeholders that might still be in place.

So, if you are interested, please stay tuned. Add the game to your wishlist, and tell your friends, colleagues and relatives about it.

We look forward for any feedback you might have, please leave them on the Google Forms link which we will include in the demo.

[h2]Tentative Roadmap:[/h2]

We are expecting a v1.0 release around May 2025, but this can potentially shift depending on feedback we receive through the Fest and later on.

[h2]TLDR:[/h2]

Small team working on the game in their free time, still early in production, hence it being rough around the edges.
